name: sartoux
description: Plugins for ACA, Kivloo and CyberScore.

plugins.name: automated-client-acquisition
plugins.description: Run cold email, LinkedIn outreach and lead generation from your AI assistant. Define your ICP, build lead lists, launch campaigns, check deliverability, triage replies and create content in your ACA workspace. One sign-in, no API keys.

plugins.name: aca-outbound-domain-sites
plugins.description: Turn bare cold-email sending domains into real, distinct landing pages — built, deployed and DNS-pointed without breaking mail.

plugins.name: kivloo
plugins.description: Draft HACCP plans, SOPs, workplace safety and maritime documents, build compliance checklists, and analyse workplace data with Kivloo.

plugins.name: cyberscore
plugins.description: Check any business domain's security from your AI assistant: email spoofing protection (SPF, DMARC, DKIM), website security, certificates and publicly reported exposed services, graded A to F with plain-English fixes. Free, no sign-up.
